acceptance_condition: All canonical object grains, PKs, FKs, and cardinalities are frozen.
Formal joint-claim grammar and evidence ceilings are machine-representable.
Identity/version/supersession rules are deterministic and tested.
Lifecycle states and transitions fail closed.
Error, uncertainty, neutral, missing, refusal, inapplicable, and source absence are distinct.
Canonical-to-runtime projection produces a loss report and blocks unsupported semantics.
Candidate scaling rules avoid all-pairs enumeration and preserve residual completeness.
Vertical-slice suite passes through all downstream lineage fields.
Existing GSS behavior can be canonically backfilled and projected without unexplained drift.
Review/approval provenance and closure hashing are specified.
Coverage/completion manifests and no-family rulings are defined.
Migration, explained-delta audit, and rollback are defined before implementation.
No respondent observations are stored in authority objects.
P2 node-catalog schema is generated from the frozen architecture, not improvised during population.
